card.name: Gaps and splits in PPI label text
card.fires_on: Small pieces in proton pump inhibitor (pantoprazole, PPI) label text: the space before a number, the P of PPI, and linking words before a condition. Also the start of a section number.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A lone space token right before a dose, duration or section number.

modes.label: Start of PPI
modes.description: The P that begins the abbreviation PPI before the word therapy.
modes.example: Use the shortest duration of<< P>>PI therapy appropriate to the condition being treated

modes.label: Linking word after GERD
modes.description: The word and joining GERD to another condition.
modes.example: intravenous pantoprazole sodium in patients with GERD<< and>> a history of EE, 86
